$comment: Stats module cases (spec/03 Stats module, rules in shared/stats.json). Each case gives the library rows exactly as GetStatsLibrary returns them (canonical snake_case; JSON columns as stored), the GetContributorRoles result, and a period. `expect` lists only the ReadingStats fields that case pins; compare those, keys case-insensitively. Numbers compare within 1e-9. Expectations were worked out by hand from the rules. `periods` pins the period builders: each `call` names a builder (year, month, custom, life, thisYear, thisMonth) with its arguments; `out` is the period, or {"error": "invalidPeriod"} for the language's argument error. thisYear/thisMonth take `now` (an instant) and `timeZone`.

cases.$comment: An entry with no read rows is one finished read, dated by last_read_date.
No rows and no last_read_date: counted, but with no finish date it's only in life.
The same entry is in life, and byMonth leaves it out (no month).
No row has finished_at but last_read_date is set: the first dateless row carries it and counts.
No dateless row: the first row started on or before last_read_date carries it. The later-started row stays open.
Every row started after last_read_date (an open re-read): the completion gets its own counted read; the open row doesn't count.
A row marked 'I don't know' (precision 0) never takes last_read_date. With no other row, nothing needs the fallback; the floor row counts with no date.
The same entry still counts once in life.
A row with a precision and progress >= 100 but no date is a finished read (life only).
Nothing finished and no last_read_date: the most recently started row counts, undated.
Two finished rows in the year: one book, two reads, pages twice, the rating once.
The library only holds the read population; an entry here with status 5 and read_count 0 would not be returned by GetStatsLibrary. Entries on another shelf after a read still count.
An audio edition: pages 0, seconds from the edition. Hours are floored.
The row has no edition: format falls back to the entry's edition (audio), but seconds come from the book, not the entry's edition.
Edition pages are used when present, even 0; null falls back to the book.
A synthetic read's edition is the entry's edition.
Formats count per read; ids other than 1, 4, 2 are left out.
March includes the 1st and the 31st, not Feb 28 or Apr 1.
A year-precision finish is stored as January 1.
Off-grid (4.3) and zero ratings are dropped; 4.5 and 5 count. Average is unrounded.
Each read adds 1 per tag on its book; ties keep first-seen order (entry order). missing counts reads with no tags in the category.

Primary credits count; a translator (even primary) and a non-primary illustrator don't; an author credited twice on a book counts it once; re-reads don't repeat a book. Sorted by books; ties keep first-seen order.
No `primary` key: a role id resolves through the roles table, with a specialization override winning; no role id falls back to the legacy text rule (Writer counts).
